body:
Host restarted with cargo run (observed by Opus2 on 2026-10-05 at 03:08Z; recorded by Fable2; a supplement to landing-integration-and-install, BUILD AND INSTALL, which is at its size limit). Greg's restart ran `cargo run --release` in the master checkout. Cargo RELINKED target/release/termal.exe in place from master's source, at 03:10:35Z. That overwrote the binary the integration owner had installed (8e4f4e30; the new hash is 6897a1bb) and broke the .bak chain. A byte compare against the clean-export build of the same commit differed only in the PE link timestamp, three debug-directory stamps and the 16-byte PDB GUID. So after such a restart: (1) do not treat the hash change as unauthorised; verify that the code is equivalent to the landed commit by that byte compare, and record the new hash; (2) keep the clean-export build output (.tmp/install-target or target/release-clean-<sha>) as the backup, since the in-place .bak may be gone; (3) master must be clean at the landed commit before any restart, because cargo builds whatever the master checkout holds.

Seen again on 2026-10-05 at about 22:26Z (train 47, f476060e; recorded by Fable2).
- The restart relinked termal.exe in place: the file and termal.d were written at 22:25:59–22:26:00Z.
- The hash went from the installed e151c0f9 to 346557f9.
- `fc /b` against the clean-export build (.tmp/install-target/release/termal.exe) showed only 23 differing bytes: the PE timestamp at 0x108, three debug-directory stamps (0x1AB6BF4, 0x1AB6C10, 0x1AB6C2C) and the 16-byte PDB GUID at 0x1AB7030. The code is equivalent.
- The clean-export build remains the backup.

Lesson for the coordinator: check this memory BEFORE reporting a hash change as a deviation. Use `fc /b` (native, seconds), not a PowerShell byte loop, which exceeds the tool timeout.

Seen again on 2026-10-06 at about 14:45Z (restart onto master 0488bed2). Cargo relinked termal.exe at 14:45:23Z; the installed 5c00cf61 became cec5ff68. `fc /b` against .tmp/install-target/release/termal.exe (5c00cf61) showed only the known stamp and GUID differences (about 27 bytes). The clean build stays the backup. (Termal::Fable2.)

Seen again on 2026-10-10 at 14:46:56Z (restart onto master 7f6281da, about 8.5 h after "restart now" at 06:20Z). Cargo relinked termal.exe at 14:46:56Z; the installed 41ececf7 became 079793a7. fc /b against .tmp/install-target/release/termal.exe showed 28 bytes: the PE timestamp at 0x108, debug stamps at 0x1B70D64/80/9C and the PDB GUID at 0x1B711B0. Code equivalent. Lesson: a long gap before the restart lets every worker's claim lapse, so the post-restart wake must tell them to recover claims and re-name roots before any gate. (Termal::Fable2.)

Seen again on 2026-10-11 at 23:06:54Z (restart onto master f2becb2b, w-a99b + w-2041). Cargo relinked termal.exe 1 s before the host started (pid 47984, 23:06:55Z). The installed 9ea7b524 became 03d1f2b3. fc /b against .tmp/install-target/release/termal.exe showed about 23 bytes: the PE timestamp at 0x108, debug stamps at 0x1B7DB44/60/7C and the PDB GUID. The code is identical. HEAD was f2becb2b with only UI files dirty, and the binary embeds no UI. (Termal::Fable2.)

Seen again on 2026-10-12 at 10:39:44Z (restart onto master d6c0ca78, w-cfcf + w-6c1d, about 5 h 15 min after "restart now" at 05:24Z). Cargo relinked termal.exe 1 s before the host started (pid 85932, 10:39:45Z; four more termal.exe processes started 10:41–10:42Z, the per-session tool servers). The installed 27d09e72 became 8253bbaf. fc /b against .tmp/install-target/release/termal.exe showed 24 bytes: the PE timestamp at 0x108, debug stamps at 0x1BA1154/70/8C and the PDB GUID at 0x1BA15B0. The code is identical, and the master checkout was clean at d6c0ca78. (Termal::Fable2.)

Seen again on 2026-10-16 at 14:54:21Z (restart onto master dae4bfd9, the P0 w-f5a3 deadlock fix), and this time NOT stamp-only (Termal::Opus2, with Termal::Fable2 #2447-#2449).
- Cargo rebuilt target/release/termal.exe in place, as a hard link to deps/termal.exe, sha256 59a77679…, 35,738,112 bytes. The installed clean build d0bdb0de… (35,737,600 bytes) survives at .tmp/install-target/release/termal.exe and stays the backup.
- `fc /b`: about 8.46 M differing bytes, because the layout shifts. `dumpbin /headers` (MSVC 14.29 HostX64\x64) shows the same sections and the same linker feature counts. Differences, in-place versus clean:
  - .text virtual size 1A3EA68 vs 1A3E948 (+0x120), raw 1A3EC00 vs 1A3EA00 (+0x200, so +512 bytes of file);
  - .rdata 6975AC vs 69756C (+0x40);
  - exception directory (.pdata) 125FB8 vs 125FE8 (−0x30, i.e. 4 fewer RUNTIME_FUNCTION entries);
  - entry point 19F67D0 vs 19F66B0.
  So the CODEGEN differs (function count and inlining), not just stamps.
- Same source (master dae4bfd9; Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, build.rs and src clean) and the same embedded rustc commit b940084d7 (1.99.0). The cause is unexplained. Candidates: the restart path's toolchain or cargo binary (the host's `cargo run --release` comes from the stable toolchain directory), or env or flags (RUSTFLAGS, CARGO_PROFILE_*). Not investigated further.
- METHOD when a byte compare is not stamp-only: show "the host carries change X" by grepping `-a -o` for a production string the change ADDED, in non-test src from `git diff BASE..COMMIT`. Count it in the running binary, the clean build and the previous backup. For the P0: "refusing Codex terminal continuation for session" counted running 1, clean 1, old c6925b5d.bak 0. Together with clean source identity, that suffices; no rebuild needed.

Seen again on 2026-10-16 at 22:45:11Z (Greg's machine REBOOT, host onto master 12e16176 = train-3a + w-b201 + w-2da7 + P0; recorded by Termal::Opus2).
- Cargo rebuilt target/release/termal.exe in place: sha256 fc5e9892…, 35,750,912 bytes, the SAME size as the clean install a54db7b9. `fc /b` still showed about 5.34 M differing bytes: codegen differs again, not stamp-only.
- String method: w-b201's "another command of this session (key " and train-3a's "unquoted shell expression or escape" each count running 1, clean 1, pre-restart 59a77679 0. The P0 control counts 1/1/1.
- The source was clean at 12e16176. The running build's identity is fc5e9892; the clean a54db7b9 in .tmp/install-target is the backup.

Seen again on 2026-10-17 at 02:22:52Z (restart onto master aeacfe69, P0 w-fa93 auto-approve; instance 8cfe02d2; recorded by Termal::Opus2). The in-place rebuild is 15d3743a…, 35,802,624 bytes, the same size as the clean 9e711201. String method: the three w-fa93 strings count running 1, clean 1, previous fc5e9892 0. The source was clean at aeacfe69. The running identity is 15d3743a; the clean 9e711201 in .tmp/install-target is the backup.
